how: We read the website of every Charlotte wedding DJ listed on Lazo (48 listings, 37 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: corporate AV production crews, a national franchise with a Charlotte page, two multi-city DJ companies, and a trade-show entertainment outfit. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
How do you handle ceremony audio outdoors, with wireless mics for vows and a backup if the venue's power or weather turns?
What is in the base price, and what are uplighting, cold sparks, photo booth and extra hours on top?

picks.name: LK Productions DJ Entertainment Company
picks.blurb: LK Productions is a mobile DJ service in Charlotte that has provided entertainment for over 25 years across North Carolina, South Carolina and Virginia. A team of trained DJs, and the site describes consulting with you to help plan the event before the music starts.

picks.name: SireSounds Audio Equipment Rentals & DJ Services
picks.blurb: SireSounds is owner-operated, one DJ with one standard, so every event gets the full rig and full attention. DJ Sire learned on two turntables at 16, ran a radio show and kept DJing through the Marine Corps; sound, lighting, wireless mics and MC work can be booked together or rented on their own.

picks.name: DJ Marty
picks.blurb: DJ Marty brings nearly 30 years and more than 400 weddings, a catalog of 125,000 songs and 57,000 music videos, and tour-grade audio and lighting. Huntersville-based, serving Charlotte, Greensboro and Winston-Salem, with wireless lapel mics so guests hear the vows.

picks.name: Remarkable Receptions, Extraordinary Wedding DJ Entertainment
picks.blurb: Remarkable Receptions is Rich, a wedding DJ and master of ceremonies specialist in Huntersville who works across the Carolinas and the Southeast. Boutique-style service built on getting to know you and your wedding party, with the MC role treated as the point, not an add-on.

picks.name: Vinylly Wed
picks.blurb: Vinylly Wed frames wedding DJing as sound design for modern couples: multi-genre music, clear planning and smooth flow for three generations and two families' cultures on one dance floor. Charlotte-based for NC and SC, with Signature and Full-Wedding service tiers and dates open for 2026 and 2027.

picks.name: Split Second Sound
picks.blurb: Split Second Sound offers multiple Charlotte DJs and packages and matches you to an entertainer through its Know Your Customer form if you do not have one in mind. A top Charlotte venue once compared it to Starbucks for consistency, which the company repeats proudly.

picks.name: Elegant Soirée Wedding DJs & Photobooths
picks.blurb: Elegant Soirée packages professional DJs with interactive photo booths for Charlotte weddings, with cold sparks, monogram spotlights and uplighting on the menu. Over 15 years in the Charlotte event industry, pitched at the modern bride who wants it stress-free.

picks.name: Platinum DJ & Photo booth
picks.blurb: Platinum DJ and Photo Booth is Lake Norman's wedding DJ and Magic Mirror photo booth outfit in Mooresville, with published wedding DJ and photo booth packages. The site cites training from Randy Bartlett's 1% Solution and Jim Cerone's perfect-host approach.

picks.name: ELEV8 EV3NTS
picks.blurb: ELEV8 EV3NTS is full-production event entertainment from Fort Mill: DJ, AV, lighting design and special effects. Founder Vrund still leads every production personally after more than eight years, and the company owns and operates its entire inventory.

picks.name: AAA Entertainment
picks.blurb: Chris Ernest of AAA Entertainment came to the Carolinas in 2006 by way of Los Angeles and a ten-year career as a professional mascot, including a championship ring with the Pistons. Huntersville MC and DJ who has worked with NBA, NFL and MLB events and now does weddings.

picks.name: Harlesound,LLC
picks.blurb: DJ Terry of Harlesound has handled couples' wedding sound for over a decade in the Piedmont and beyond, and also officiates ceremonies. Albemarle-based, affordable by his own description, with corporate live-event work across the eastern US.

picks.name: Maks Entertainment
picks.blurb: Maks Entertainment in Weddington offers DJ, MC and dholi, curating custom music sets that blend genres for receptions and afterparties. The site is short on history but clear on the offer: set lists built from your own taste.
